```text
# #2852: Patch: drop the printed-data readback tests from the sets #1140 did not reach
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

### Kind

Architecture

### Why

#1140 removed #1125's pattern 1a from Core, Classic, Classic+ and Meditative. Pattern 1a is the card-script tests that only read printed cost, stats, type, tags or declaration shape back from `catalog.json` and take no action. It also wrote the rule into BUILD.md, REVIEW.md B3, `crates/cards/README.md` and `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md`: a must-pass clause that names only printed data is proved by `crates/cards/tests/cross/catalog.rs`.

Three sets came after #1140 or were outside its reach, and readback tests have accumulated in them. A name-only grep (`fn (is_a_|radiant_is_|prints_|printed_|its_tags_|declares_)`) finds about 32 in `stinkyscape/`, 6 in `meditative_plus/` and 1 in `training_grounds/`. More may exist under other names, since a name match is not proof either way.

### What to change

- Read `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` first (CLAUDE.md rule 10), along with #1125's pattern 1a and #1140's plan on #1125.
- In `crates/cards/src/scripts/{stinkyscape,meditative_plus,training_grounds}/` only, delete each `#[test]` that takes no action and asserts only printed data or declaration shape that `catalog.rs` already proves. Delete any helper, test `mod` or import that this leaves unused.
- Do the same, under the same rule, for any readback added to the four older sets since #1140 (`git log 6b6cbcb0 --since=2026-10-17 -- crates/cards/src/scripts/{core,classic,classic_plus,meditative}`). Stop at 40 files in total.
- **Keep:** a test with an R-id token in its name (CLAUDE.md rule 3), unless the ruling's `proven_in` keeps another proof (never run `cargo jackioh spec index`). Keep any test that is the last one in its file. Keep any test that is the only proof of a BUILD must-pass clause (M9 to M12's tables for these sets) that names more than printed data.
- Change no card's non-test code, `catalog.json` or `patches/`. `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` must name no card.

### Acceptance

- `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo test -p jackioh-cards`, `cargo jackioh spec check` and `cargo jackioh catalog check` are green.
- No more than 40 files change, every one of them under `crates/cards/src/scripts/`.
- The PR lists every deleted test by file, with the count per set.

### Blocked by, part of

None. Follows #1125 and #1140. Siblings: #2846 to #2851.

### Difficulty (a guess)

medium: card files, but deletion only, within one crate and fewer than 40 files, under a rule #1140 already set.

### Priority

No priority

### Who does it

The night bot (bot:build)
```
